name: @petsinmycity/knowledge
description: Knowledge Graph storage foundation for PetsInMyCity. Async, provenance-tracked, versioned knowledge behind a KnowledgeStore abstraction (ADR-0027). Production durable storage is EMG Loop (system of record; persists via Neon) through LoopKnowledgeStore; SQLite is retained for local development and tests only. No vendor DB SDK ships in the deployed path.
